T01_PERSISTENCE.name: Local Persistence & Bounded Aggregate Tables
T01_PERSISTENCE.description: Drift SQLite database with bounded aggregate rows for word exposure, content progress, and mastery evidence.

T02_TOKENIZER_SERVICE.name: Chinese Tokenizer & Golden Segmentation
T02_TOKENIZER_SERVICE.description: Single deterministic tokenizer (dart_jieba) with embedded dictionary.

T03_STORY_EDITORIAL_CHOICE.name: Curate Target Stories Corpus
T03_STORY_EDITORIAL_CHOICE.description: Human decision & selection of the initial ~10 core short stories from which all beginner vocabulary is backward-derived.

T04_TARGET_LEXICON_EXTRACTION.name: Extract Target Lexicon for Bootstrap
T04_TARGET_LEXICON_EXTRACTION.description: Tokenize selected stories and extract the exact ~100-150 core Hanzi/words required to achieve 100% i+1 comprehension.

T05_AUDIO_ASSET_PIPELINE.name: Produce Native Pronunciation Audio
T05_AUDIO_ASSET_PIPELINE.description: Source/record clean native audio for target Hanzi and sentence narration (independent parallel creative task).

T06_VISUAL_ASSET_PIPELINE.name: Produce Concept Visuals & Story Illustrations
T06_VISUAL_ASSET_PIPELINE.description: Create minimalist illustrations and concept visual assets for bootstrap items and story scenes (independent parallel task).

T07_BOOTSTRAP_EXPOSURE_CORPUS.name: Author Bootstrap Exposure JSON Corpus
T07_BOOTSTRAP_EXPOSURE_CORPUS.description: Generate pre-tokenized JSON content items for ~100-150 target words with exact offsets, audio refs, and visual refs.

T08_PURE_EXPOSURE_ENGINE.name: Pure Exposure Phase & Repetition Accumulator
T08_PURE_EXPOSURE_ENGINE.description: Accumulate ~600 exposures across bootstrap vocabulary without testing or SRS interruption.

T09_BUTTONLESS_ZEN_READER.name: Button-Free Zen Reader UI
T09_BUTTONLESS_ZEN_READER.description: Zero button bars, zero Anki grades; seamless screen tap/gesture progression on calm paper canvas.

T10_LEVEL_INJECTION_HOOK.name: Simulated Level Testing Hook (0..100)
T10_LEVEL_INJECTION_HOOK.description: Support --dart-define=LEVEL=0..100 to instantly simulate any learner knowledge state for rapid testing.

T11_CONTENT_SELECTOR_V2.name: Content Selector V2 (i+1 Story Orchestration)
T11_CONTENT_SELECTOR_V2.description: Orchestrate transition from pure exposure units to the target short stories once exposure threshold is met.

T12_POST_EXPOSURE_SUBORDINATE_SRS.name: Subordinate Sentence-Based SRS
T12_POST_EXPOSURE_SUBORDINATE_SRS.description: Unlock non-intrusive sentence-based FSRS review only after the ~600 exposure bootstrap threshold is passed.
